attrs.evidence: Kernel L-CERT-1 (positive: 96 receipts fully re-executed; naive edit dies at cert-id-mismatch) and L-CERT-2 (15 laundered forgeries with honestly recomputed commitments each refused on a distinct semantic re-derivation, plus the hollow zero-receipt certificate with 999,999 fabricated runs). grid_check v2.1 repeats the engine-free half: commitments and aggregates recomputed, completeness, profile/refs/claims against this grid's data.
attrs.statement: scheduling-freedom claims travel as SchedulerCertificate v2: every field is DERIVED (checker recomputes it), COMMITTED (inside cert_id = H("TRVM-SCHEDCERT-v2" | canonical committed-field serialization)), or INFORMATIONAL (declared non-authoritative). The EVIDENCE BASIS is the run manifest — one receipt per run — which the checker RE-EXECUTES deterministically; aggregates are recomputed by arithmetic over verified receipts; claims are verified semantically; law refs must be justified by verified claims; exhibits are witnesses tied into the manifest, not the evidence basis
